releases.notes:
### Information
In this version, many fixes are added involving the cauldron block:
1. Water cauldrons break your fall
2. Cauldrons cannot be filled with water in the Nether
3. Entities are considered wet in water cauldrons (aka endermen take damage in water cauldrons)
